gen-gf-calligraffitti-manrope: Calligraffitti scrawls like marker on paper, friendly and tall through the middle. Manrope follows with bright open curves and a steady line, so longer text goes down smoothly, while the handwriting is better saved for a few words.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-montserrat: Montserrat glides along with generous white space leading into every curve, set beneath the marker-drawn Calligraffitti heading. Both stay friendly, but the handwriting is best tasted lightly, never at length.
gen-gf-caprasimo-fs-rowan: Rowan reads openly, with generous curves and thin strokes about half the weight of thick ones, beneath the tightly wound Caprasimo. A longer page of it would feel friendly, never crowded.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-fs-gambetta: Gambetta moves with a mellow, bookish modulation under the eye. Castoro Titling above it has heavy shoulders and hairline joins on the m, made for a short line rather than a page.
gen-gf-cause-fs-neco: Friendly and inviting, Cause looks hand-drawn, its e opened wide and its diagonals matching its stems. Neco takes over with a measured swell from hairline to stem, dignified through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-cherry-bomb-one-fs-rowan: Cherry Bomb One hits hard with pinched terminals and a monoweight skeleton. Rowan does the quieter work, with generous curves and thin strokes half the weight of thick ones.
gen-gf-cherry-cream-soda-fs-rowan: Wide-spaced and loud: Cherry Cream Soda stretches out like it owns the room. Rowan tucks in underneath with gentle modulation, keeping paragraphs comfortable and giving the sparse letters something warm to lean on.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-kadwa: Kadwa brings open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, giving it an editorial feel beneath the commanding Cherry Swash. The heading's lowercase sits moderate, so the body looks distinctly taller.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text lets its lowercase fill most of the letter height, with a visible entrance into every curve. Noticia Text is the one for reading, while Cherry Swash, with no hairlines to squint at, handles the loud work.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads wide and approachable, with gaps between curve ends and stems, under the casual Comic Neue. One loosens things up, while the other holds everything steady.
